changelog:
game-asset-generator 1.0.0

- Initial release of the AI Game Asset Toy Generator skill.
- Generate toy multi-view sheets and 3D models using state-of-the-art 3D APIs (Tripo/Meshy/etc) via OneKey Agent Gateway.
- Supports workflows for converting prompts/images into drafts, and then into 3D asset generation tasks with progress polling.
- Provides templates for Figurine, Stuffed Toy, 3D Printing, Game Assets, and Architecture Toy generation.
- Includes asset size presets for easy scaling.
- API access and authentication managed via DEEPNLP_ONEKEY_ROUTER_ACCESS variable.
summary: AI Game Asset Toy Generator Generate Toy Multi View Sheets and 3D Models Generator using SOTA 3D APIs such as Tripo/Meshy/etc served on OneKey Agent Gateway by Craftsman Agent, useful for AI Figurine, Stuffed Toy, 3D Printing, Game Asset and Architecture Toy Generation
